reason: Revision r2 answers REV-20260926-23. The safety claim is now made per wording family (0 of at least 60 independent families, bound about 4.9%), and the below-2% bound and the enforcement unlock are withdrawn. Sanitation is shared across arms, and the spec evaluates the real one-call-per-serving policy. A benign task-success guard and every gate-harm flag are reported whatever the framing result is. It can move B24 (lead, 44 author-written lines) by measuring what the agent actually does, and a pass only puts the gate in shadow mode.
